# Independent CENC test vectors

`cenc.bin` and `clear.bin` are synthetic, non-media ISO BMFF vectors generated by
`app/test/support/cenc_fixture.cjs` using Node/OpenSSL. They contain no user data.
The public test key is `00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff`. Rust tests compare the
actual C-backed random-access stream against the independently generated clear
bytes; these vectors are compiled only into test executables, not the HAP.
